system.description:
Extends a building's shelter to magic: a quick Hearth-Ward for a room or cottage, or a permanent Sanctum ritual for a whole structure.

Spell. Hearth-Ward: Cunning test against the chosen ward level; one small building or chamber up to 50 feet. Each degree protects the structure for an hour.

Ritual. Alignment: Sanctum: Challenging (9) Cunning, time by area. Invocation: Routine (6) or higher Knowledge, 3 hours. Unleashing: Formidable (12) or higher Will, by the ward strength sought: a lasting sanctum.

Art of Warding — full rules: Sword Chronicle p. 106.
system.resonances: Incenses and protective oils (30 silver drachmas), or occult inlays and seals over doors and windows (varies).
